name: varg-character-fitness
description: Makes AI fitness characters on varg (coaches, gym creators, athletes, bodybuilders) with real muscle and skin, a locked signature outfit and colour, and catalog-style wording that gets sports bras, leggings and shirtless athletes past false moderation blocks. Builds the character sheet ready for workout scenes and video. Use when someone asks for a fitness influencer, gym girl or gym guy, a trainer for an app, an athlete for an activewear or supplement ad, or a character in a sports bra that keeps getting blocked. Part of varg-character-design (definition, sheet, reuse in video).
